paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.67% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.78%) and Dow Jones weakest (-0.72%). Brent crude changed -2.77% to 110.03. Gold changed -0.38% to 4,044.8. Bitcoin changed -0.81% to 80,137.9609. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.045%, a relative move of -1.96%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+16.02%) and Santander (-12.04%) moved the most.
